observations.body: Cloud covers the Tent, the LORD’s glory fills the tabernacle, Moses cannot enter, and the cloud and fire govern Israel’s journeys.
observations.label: Cloud and glory fill the dwelling and guide Israel

observations.body: Cloud and glory fill the dwelling and guide Israel belongs to tablets and dwelling in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 40:34–38 supplies consequence evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: What follows from Sinai

observations.body: The tablets and dwelling instructions develop the consequences of Sinai presence; they are not additional lines inside the Ten Words.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 40:34–38 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Cloud and glory fill the dwelling and guide Israel follows from Sinai while remaining distinct from the words and actions at the mountain itself.
payload.title: Cloud and glory fill the dwelling and guide Israel
